response.rationale: Both expressions can denote paper towel, but the Malaysian entry is not a clean national contrast: Malaysian usage also includes “tisu dapur,” while “tuala kertas” is a valid alternative. The card should qualify the forms as usage preferences rather than implying mutually exclusive national vocabulary. No false-friend contrast is present.
